name: Paste
fit: Messaging, account, and support products built from a theme of tokens.
principles: Compose with primitives and tokens. A theme package and a theme provider supply every value. Accessibility belongs to the component.
color: Background, text, border, and data-visualization tokens, plus error, warning, success, and neutral.
typography: A sans family with heading, text, and display styles.
spacing: A space scale consumed by stack and box primitives.
shape: Radii for controls and cards. Shadows are tokens.
elevation: Shadow tokens for card and overlay.
layout: Page composition from stack, grid, and column primitives.
icons: A product icon set plus illustrative icons.
components: Button, input, modal, alert, table, and tabs. Patterns combine those components. Each one reads tokens only.
adapt: Keep the rule that components only use tokens from the theme. Retheme color and type for this product.
